subject: AWS Marketplace listing: visibility, creative guidance and resell matrix
messages:
From: Jessica Martin <jessica.martin@amazon.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + ACME listing visibility and co-sell alignment

Hi Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks again for the time earlier. ACME Cloud Solutions (Mike copied) is ready to go live with their AWS Marketplace listing and wants clarity on two items we talked about: 1) hero positioning / images that pass AWS creative review, and 2) a simple resell/co-sell matrix so both sellers and account teams know discounted entitlements and margins.

Can you share your recommended hero copy + image requirements and a one-sheet that maps: customer scenario -> SKU to recommend -> co-sell play (e.g., joint lead gen, referral, or co-sell discount)? We typically need this to finalize offer visibility and apply the co-sell badge.

Attachment: AWS_MARKETPLACE_GUIDELINES_v2026.pdf (referenced)

Jessica
AWS Marketplace Program Manager
Amazon Web Services

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jessica Martin <jessica.martin@amazon.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, mike.whitman <mike.whitman@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACME listing visibility and co-sell alignment

Thanks Jessica — nice to meet you, Mike.

Quick plan below and I attached assets we think accelerate approval and co-sell ops: a hero image (redwood_hero_v2.png) optimized to AWS sizing, and a draft resell matrix (resell_offer_matrix_v1.xlsx). High level guidance:

- Hero angle: "Run reliable, cost-efficient LLM inference at production scale." Short subline: "Multi-environment inference: hosted, dedicated, or private — predictable latency and unit economics." Keep copy under 140 characters for the hero slot.
- Imagery: use an abstract data/edge illustration (no real person faces), 1600x600 px, include subtle AWS marketplace banding in lower right corner (we'll provide mask). Avoid product screenshots with customer PII.
- CTA: "Get started — free pilot" (links to trial private offer).

On the resell matrix: we mapped three entry scenarios (startup POC, SMB production, enterprise regulated). For each we recommend SKU mapping and suggested co-sell treatments (referral / joint lead / co-funded trial). See the attached spreadsheet for suggested discount tiers and who owns the lead.

Next steps proposed:
1) Jessica: quick check if the hero copy + image constraints look good vs AWS creative rules.
2) Mike: confirm which scenarios ACME wants to enable at launch (POC / SMB / Enterprise).
3) Ben/Vanessa: finalize co-sell ops (who logs leads in the console, SLA back-and-forth).

Thanks — I can iterate on the hero copy once Mike confirms target audience.

— Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Programs, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Mike Whitman <mike.whitman@acme-corp.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: jessica.martin@amazon.com, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACME listing visibility and co-sell alignment

Kimberly — thanks, that looks sensible. For launch we want POC and SMB tiers enabled; Enterprise can be gated until we have SOC 2 evidence in the listing (working on that).

A couple of asks from our side: the hero should call out "low-latency inference" explicitly and we prefer CTA text that mentions "Request trial" rather than "Get started" — conversion data from our team suggests stronger intent. Also can you confirm whether the marketplace trial can be limited to specific AWS accounts (we need to restrict pilots to named customers)?

— Mike Whitman
Head of Partnerships, Acme Cloud Solutions

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, mike.whitman <mike.whitman@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jessica.martin <jessica.martin@amazon.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACME listing visibility and co-sell alignment

Thanks Mike — good call on the CTA and latency callout. Small edits I recommend:

- Hero line: "Low-latency LLM inference for production applications." (keeps it tight and search-friendly)
- Subline: "Hosted, dedicated, or private deployments with predictable cost and SLA-backed throughput."
- CTA: "Request trial" (we'll map the Marketplace private offer to the trial flow so it can be scoped to named AWS accounts).

Vanessa — can you add the final column in the matrix that lists the lead owner and the expected follow-up SLA (e.g., Redwood responds in 48 hours)? Also, include a sample HubSpot campaign name so the field sales teams can tag leads properly.

I attached a quick mock of the trial flow and mapping.

— Ben Carter
Director, GTM Programs, Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, mike.whitman <mike.whitman@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jessica.martin <jessica.martin@amazon.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + ACME listing visibility and co-sell alignment

All — added the lead-owner and SLA columns to the resell matrix (see resell_offer_matrix_v1.xlsx). Short summary of my changes:

- Lead owner: Redwood SDR for initial qualification (48 business hours), then AE handoff for POC/SMB; Enterprise handoff requires Security/Compliance pre-qualification.
- Co-sell badge eligibility: POC + SMB with co-funded trial (10% off list) qualifies; Enterprise requires validated SOC 2 evidence and an active account manager at AWS.
- HubSpot naming: ACME_AWS_COSELL_YYYYMM

Jessica — if that matches AWS expectations, can you flag the listing to get the co-sell badge review and we'll sign the AWS seller agreement. I've uploaded the signed copy to DocuSign and attached the acknowledgement (aws_seller_agreement_docusign.pdf).

If all good I'll push the final hero PNG (redwood_hero_v2.png) and confirm the private offer mapping to named accounts.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
